intro: Become a Yoga Alliance certified Yin yoga teacher with our comprehensive 100 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Bali. Whether it is for recreation or as a sportsman who wants to enhance flexibility and reduce incidences of injury, Yin Yoga is here to revolutionize your life. We also offer a short Yin yoga course: 50 hour Yin yoga teacher training in Bali.
Unlike most other forms of yoga that are practiced today, Yin Yoga takes the initiative on a slow journey, deep into the tissues of the body such as the ligaments, fascia and tendons.

Life is filled with stress— from heavy training sessions, long office days or hours on your feet. Applying Yin Yoga is a great boon especially for those areas that tend to be tighter such as hip region, chest, lower back and legs.
The biggest difference of Yin Yoga is that it primarily targets the connective tissues. Such items as bolsters, blocks and blankets are employed to make sure that the practice is free from injuries.
